items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Sy contributed a lot to Jimmie Lunceford's band... Willie played... We were just all buddies.

ctx.x: So now, Willie Smith was -- wasn't Willie Smith writing arrangements and so forth?
Yeah, Willie wrote some, but when Sy got in there, well, it all backed down a little bit because Sy contributed a lot to Jimmie Lunceford's band. Wilcox even wrote.
